description: This file contains unit tests for detecting inline evaluation patterns within command-line arguments, specifically targeting interpreter eval flags and command carriers. It tests functions that identify whether a command invokes inline code execution or uses specific allowlist patterns.

methods.name: detectInterpreterInlineEvalArgv
methods.description: Detects whether the input argument list corresponds to a command executing inline code via an interpreter eval flag.

methods.name: describeInterpreterInlineEval
methods.description: Provides a human-readable description of the inline eval pattern detected.

methods.name: isInterpreterLikeAllowlistPattern
methods.description: Checks if a given path matches known interpreter-like allowlist patterns.
